name: 模拟华附
english_description: A campus-life simulation mudlib set at the real-world campus of South China Normal University's Affiliated High School (Huafu) in Guangzhou, with no wuxia or fantasy trappings — its map (`d/huafu/`) faithfully recreates real school locations like teaching buildings, dorms, the computer room, and the library. Character creation picks a personality type (studious, lively, calm, or athletic) instead of the usual sect/race choice, and a boot-camp-style newbie orientation walks players through the game's economy (bike-shed attendant work, dishwashing at McDonald's for cash) before dropping them at a hub where a numbered menu (1-6: Juqing Garden, teaching building, office building, library, McDonald's, back-gate garden) stands in for the usual compass-direction exploration — closer to a mobile game's UI than a typical wuxia MUD. Quests are timed fetch-and-return jobs claimed directly from an NPC via a `quest` command rather than the classic `ask...about`, with a practice bird on the lawn for newcomers to try it on.
